bc_picnic_wall.blurb: Picnic Wall is the upper wall at the forested Hayward Lake crag near Abbotsford in the Fraser Valley. It holds nine short routes, mostly sport with a few trad lines and one top-rope, running from easy fifth class up to about 5.10, with the bulk of them at 5.8. The wall faces southeast, takes plenty of sun into the afternoon and dries quickly after rain. The low angle and easy top-rope setup make it a good pick for learning or for climbing with newer partners. A string of lookouts sits just above it, with long views over the valley to the surrounding peaks.
